konu: Future Career Idioms, Entrepreneurship Qualities, Connected Speech and Writing a Note to Your Future Self
ciktilar: E11.1.L1. Students will be able to detect unfamiliar words and idioms in a recorded text about future jobs.
E11.1.S1. Students will be able to talk about qualities of entrepreneurs and future career plans using reduced auxiliary forms.
E11.1.R1. Students will be able to analyze CVs, letters of intent, and motivational notes to one's future self.
hatirla: Career idioms express working attitudes: 'climb the corporate ladder' (get promoted), 'think outside the box' (innovative creativity), 'call it a day' (finish working).
Successful entrepreneurs demonstrate visionary leadership, adaptability to emerging AI tech, high risk tolerance and resilience against initial market failures.
In natural connected speech, future auxiliary verbs reduce: 'going to' contracts to 'gonna', 'want to' to 'wanna', and 'I will' to 'I'll' in casual dialogues.
